vc_checking.summary: All five current manual witnesses are semantically proofable under the approved xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg predicates and xizi_double_link_size(nodes) = Zlength nodes. The initialization, loop-step, and return obligations form one connected segment-unfold/segment-extension/list-length proof family; no annotation or seed-spec repair is required.

natural_language_analysis.summary: The proof is a direct separation-logic traversal argument. Each disjunctive generated witness can be closed through its resource-complete first alternative. xizi_dllseg_unfold exposes the next data node; a proved segment-snoc helper moves the current node from the suffix boundary into the traversed prefix; Zlength equations and the global 32-bit size bound discharge the unsigned increment side condition; terminal cases force the remaining segment to nil and permit xizi_dll_close.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open or unfold the sentinel DLL segment, move one node across the prefix/suffix boundary, preserve all link resources, normalize list concatenation/Zlength, and close the DLL at loop exit.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use xizi_dll_open/xizi_dllseg_unfold/xizi_dll_close plus a proved segment-extension helper and a disjoint-link-address fact.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Normalize xizi_double_link_size, app/cons/nil Zlength equations, and prove the 32-bit counter increment cannot wrap from the global length bound and the nonempty suffix.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All five witnesses belong to one function and one tightly coupled sentinel-segment traversal/closure proof family. Keeping them together permits one suffixed helper family instead of duplicate helpers across groups; five witnesses are below the controller limit of twelve.

proof_groups.grouping_reason: One connected proof family over the same function, dllseg invariant, list partition, and three helper shapes; one five-witness group is within the max_witnesses_per_group=12 limit and avoids cross-group helper duplication.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove initialization by xizi_dll_open; prove loop preservation by xizi_dllseg_unfold plus a segment-snoc helper and Zlength/no-wrap arithmetic; prove terminal nonempty closure by forcing todo=[] and applying the same segment-snoc helper followed by xizi_dll_close; prove the empty terminal case with xizi_dll_empty_rev.
